usageNotes: Removes a network interface configuration from the node's /etc/network/interfaces — the change is staged and does not take effect until the network is reloaded (use PUT /nodes/{node}/network to apply). Only removes the Proxmox-managed config entry; the physical NIC or bond members themselves are unaffected. Requires Sys.Modify on the target node.

examples.summary: Delete a Linux bridge that is no longer needed

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named interface's configuration from the node; any VMs or containers bound to that interface will lose network connectivity once the change is applied.
tips: The deletion is staged — run PUT /nodes/{node}/network (reload) to commit it; until then the interface remains active.
Verify no VMs or CTs reference the interface before deleting to avoid silent connectivity loss.
Returns null on success; check the node's pending network config with GET /nodes/{node}/network to confirm the entry is gone before reloading.
If the node is a cluster member, ensure the interface is not used for corosync/cluster traffic before removing it.
